new_en:
L (Left Stick) | Move | Move character direction with L (Left Stick) | 
R (Right Stick) | Camera | Adjust camera angle up or down with R (Right Stick) | 
A | Interact / Use Item / Move Furniture (Hold) | Interact with environment, talk to NPCs, use items; hold to move furniture | 
B | Cancel | Cancel current action or exit menu with B | 
X | Inventory | Open inventory screen with X | 
Y | Pick up Item | Pick up an item from the ground. | 
D-Pad Up | Tool Ring | Open the tool wheel to select a tool quickly. | 
D-Pad Left / Right | Change Tool | Switch to another tool in your pockets by cycling left or right. | 
D-Pad Down | Store Tool | Immediately put the tool you are holding back into your pockets. | 
ZL | NookPhone | Open the applications on the NookPhone. | 
ZR | Reactions | Open menu showing gestures and emotions | 
R | Chat | Open text input field for conversation | 
- (Minus) | Save & Quit | Save data and exit current gameplay session | 
+ (Plus) | Pause | Pause game temporarily to enter system menu |
